PATTERN: Declarative k3s manifests + Makefile for managing all VPS-hosted apps
WHERE: ~/Desktop/Projects/vps-platform/
HOW:
  make add-app NAME=productx DOMAIN=productx.com IMAGE=ghcr.io/ned/productx:latest
  make sync APP=productx
  make status          # all pods
  make logs APP=productx
  make delete-app APP=productx
  make sync-all        # redeploy everything
FRESH VPS: bootstrap.sh + make sync-all

STRUCTURE:
  apps/openclaw/  — OpenClaw AI agent (first migrated app)
  apps/_template/ — base template for new apps (Next+Postgres pattern)
  cluster/        — cert-manager, ClusterIssuer manifests
  scripts/        — deploy.sh, sync.sh
  bootstrap.sh    — fresh VPS setup

NOTE: initial git commit not yet made. MEMORY.md added to folder for Claude project context.
